shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab carved in low relief
horizontal row of repeated rectangular/arched units across the top
profile animal or bird head with prominent eye and beak/snout
justification: The most specific correspondence is the format: a tall upright slab whose top edge carries a row of discrete repeated rectangular/arched compartments, below which the field is divided into stacked figural registers containing profile-headed creatures. The biggest difference is the manner of carving and density: A is sparse, shallow and linear with large areas of blank ground and isolated naturalistic animals, whereas B is a dense, deeply modelled, framed composition dominated by a single elaborately costumed frontal figure amid packed ornamental and sign-like blocks.
